name: B10-0212/2026 (ECR) – The need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It sets out its opinion on how to fight cyberbullying and online harassment, especially among children. It says existing EU rules, above all the Digital Services Act, should be fully applied and enforced before any new laws are added. It asks online platforms and video game companies to do more to protect minors, and says criminal law should stay a national matter.

- No new law: Parliament wants existing rules enforced first.
- Affects platforms, game makers and children online.
- Next: sent to the Council and Commission; no binding effect.
